policy.exact_name_search_note: Exact-name/code-string checks for several current methods (LargeMonitor, SCOPE/conformal, Double Ratchet, Memento, ArgusAgent, DT-Solver, astrocyte, HARD-Both, common random numbers, confidence sequence/e-process) found no direct O repository hit; absence was used only as supporting evidence, never as proof of conceptual absence.

assessments.o_overlap: O already carries freshness/source-clock invalidation and long-horizon recovery triggers, but not frozen-representation CKA plus calibrated CUSUM drift detection or its closed-loop alarm controller.
assessments.uncertainty_scope: Released alarm/reset/warm-up parameters remain incomplete; no O-like FAR/delay calibration exists.

assessments.o_overlap: No quantile-calibrated drift-score controller with persistence plus post-alarm freeze is implemented or evaluated in O.
assessments.uncertainty_scope: Source evidence is tabular/sensor drift and released code is incomplete; not direct same-label semantic drift evidence.

assessments.o_overlap: O has held-out/protected evaluation and exact scope rules, but no drift-episode contract combining Episode Recall, FAR, alarm rate and normalized detection time with leave-one-dataset-out tuning.
assessments.uncertainty_scope: Benchmark scope is drift detection; metrics do not by themselves establish task-quality improvement.

assessments.o_overlap: O uses model judges, internal CI and external evidence tiers, but has no online residual-variance certificate that governs when a cheap proxy may substitute for expensive ground truth.
assessments.uncertainty_scope: PROBE theory assumes paired proxy/reward observations and an OLS/chi-square residual model.

assessments.o_overlap: O already activates candidates only after scoped comparison and preserves target/protected regressions, but lacks a statistical lower-bound-on-transfer-gain rule that adaptively chooses how much historical/source evidence to borrow.
assessments.uncertainty_scope: Source guarantee is ridge/linear regression with target calibration data.

assessments.o_overlap: No explicit two-part estimator in O separates pooled shared structure from target-only sparse correction with distinct statistical-uncertainty and transfer-bias radii.
assessments.uncertainty_scope: TJAP assumes MNL demand and sparse cross-market shifts; broad transfer is not guaranteed.

assessments.o_overlap: O already freezes matched scenarios/routes and uses common tasks for paired comparisons, but it does not adaptively decide whether the next evaluation should reuse an old scenario or buy a fresh one.
assessments.uncertainty_scope: CRN benefit depends on scenario effects being largely common; over-reuse can bias toward scenario-specific optima.

assessments.o_overlap: Prior O overlap remains: scoped historical evidence is reused, but no explicit bias-bound admission with a live target-only shadow is implemented.
assessments.uncertainty_scope: Current source only adds adjacent PROBE/Triple-S patterns; it does not solve the original unknown-bias setting.

assessments.o_overlap: O uses matched/frozen scenarios but has not evaluated covariance-aware allocation or adaptive old-seed/new-seed choice.
assessments.uncertainty_scope: Current update is KG-CRN-adjacent and does not establish non-Gaussian robustness.

assessments.o_overlap: O has held-out task blocks but no time-uniform confidence sequence for the running average conditional mean of one bounded statistic per completed task.
assessments.uncertainty_scope: Covers the realized/adaptive task sequence, not automatic generalization to an unseen task population.

assessments.o_overlap: No bounded betting confidence sequence under a shared conditional mean exists in O.
assessments.uncertainty_scope: The constant conditional mean is a substantive assumption and can fail under adaptive/heterogeneous task choice.

assessments.o_overlap: O has evidence objects and held-out scorers but no composition of task-level conditional e-variables into a safe outer e-process.
assessments.uncertainty_scope: Each inner task e-variable must itself be valid; the wrapper does not solve within-task dependence.

assessments.o_overlap: O runs matched route comparisons but has no time-uniform weak-null test on paired bounded score differences.
assessments.uncertainty_scope: Forecasting source domain differs from repeated-rollout agent benchmarks; one task must remain the outer unit.

assessments.o_overlap: O already separates protected control-plane authority, prompt/context safeguards and evaluation, but has no matched adaptive-attack study of jointly evolving policy and gate modules or routing-starvation effects.
assessments.uncertainty_scope: HARD evidence is one LLM-agent defense study and not independently replicated.

assessments.o_overlap: O tracks protected regression risk and rejects self-reported success, but does not explicitly report attack success, attack-free benign utility and utility-under-attack as a joint security objective.
assessments.uncertainty_scope: Observed collapse is backbone/harness-specific.

assessments.o_overlap: The specific HARD v1 table/prose contradiction is not present in O; O's generic provenance/readback discipline is only a process analogue.
assessments.uncertainty_scope: This is a source-reporting defect, not evidence about method effectiveness.

assessments.o_overlap: O has checkpoints, source clocks, stale detection and recovery, but no budgeted audit/checkpoint placement rule based on verification age times downstream causal impact.
assessments.uncertainty_scope: Evidence is multi-agent corruption/attack settings; single-agent O transfer is untested.

assessments.o_overlap: O supports invalidation, rollback and protected state, but does not explicitly separate causal-object fault localization from temporal rewind-target selection using dependency/LCA impact scores.
assessments.uncertainty_scope: Evidence is discrete spatial graph memory; version rollback can hurt in some cells.

assessments.o_overlap: O has distinct scorers and held-out checks but no conformal accepted-set risk control with explicit abstention/coverage collapse for pairwise model judgments.
assessments.uncertainty_scope: Exchangeability can fail under search-distribution shift; corruption study is calibration-label noise, not search-loop judge noise.

assessments.o_overlap: No variance-adaptive allocation of repeated judge calls across candidate comparisons is implemented in O.
assessments.uncertainty_scope: Source objective is mean-score estimation; stable systematic bias is not captured by variance.

assessments.o_overlap: O's WORK_STRATEGY already has explicit method-family concentration detection, heterogeneous search after over-concentration, and a finite same-family threshold; the core selective-focus-versus-diversity control is therefore already represented.
assessments.uncertainty_scope: O has not evaluated Elo-style temperature or opponent pools; exact 20/200/2000 temperatures are setup-specific.

assessments.o_overlap: O already treats self-evaluation as inadmissible for AGI proof, separates scorer identities in held-out evaluation, and prioritizes independent external evidence; the core 'agreement is not correctness' principle is explicit.
assessments.uncertainty_scope: GPQA/AIME consistency behavior is not identical to open-ended agent judging.

assessments.o_overlap: No astrocyte-like slow modulatory state plus eligibility-trace metaplastic update exists in O.
assessments.uncertainty_scope: Code, independent reproduction and task-boundary state semantics remain unresolved.

assessments.o_overlap: O has recursive context routing but no Hopfield/astrocyte simplex-gain dynamical memory whose fixed point implements softmax-like attention.
assessments.uncertainty_scope: Evidence is small synthetic associative memory (N≈20–30), with no modern architecture transfer or public implementation established.

assessments.o_overlap: O has persistent memory/context routing and matched held-out evaluation, but has not causally separated no-memory stream adaptation from memory-specific gain under a frozen paper-era Memento protocol.
assessments.uncertainty_scope: Table-4 no-CBR iteration operator and exact paper-era case bank remain publicly unresolved.

assessments.o_overlap: O already protects prompts/workflows from direct model edits, uses host-side fence/CAS authority, and requires deterministic authorization/readback before mutation; the core evidence-versus-authority separation is materially implemented.
assessments.uncertainty_scope: O still needs an explicit audit that writable builder/tool contexts cannot call privileged transition primitives through imports or equivalent side channels.

assessments.o_overlap: O has recursive situation-dependent branching/context materialization and heterogeneous-search policy, but no learned value-plus-unexplored-policy-mass controller that dynamically widens branch count per state.
assessments.uncertainty_scope: Historical Lean/Isabelle models are weaker; value calibration and modern substrate costs are absent.

assessments.o_overlap: O already has multiple evidence tiers, deterministic CI and external-evidence readiness, but no explicit failure-class-to-observability-channel router whose detector conjunction gates scientific promotion.
assessments.uncertainty_scope: AI CFD planted-failure evidence is one domain; the VLM gate has false positives and a convergence blind spot.

assessments.o_overlap: O can persist failures, replan and withhold claims, but severe self-identified contradictions are not universally forced into re-execute/replan/withhold closure before promotion.
assessments.uncertainty_scope: AutoResearchEval shows prevalence, not causal benefit of the proposed closure controller.

assessments.o_overlap: O has no learned per-turn reward redistribution/post-training loop for its research-agent policy; current O is primarily inference-time orchestration.
assessments.uncertainty_scope: Faraday lineage is multi-change and TIPS evidence is search-QA, not autonomous science.

assessments.o_overlap: O values independent/orthogonal evidence and uses distinct scorer/runtime paths, but has no explicit observability-matched orthogonality contract across every promoted claim.
assessments.uncertainty_scope: AI CFD adds one physical-science instance, not a universal validator stack.

assessments.o_overlap: O has candidate lifecycle, held-out/frozen evaluation, replaceable executors and external evidence boundaries, but not a co-evolving metric/skill loop with a locked audit set, anchor validity guards and outside final judge over 100 rounds.
assessments.uncertainty_scope: Three-seed/40–48-item held-out sets are small; no anytime-valid/global repeated-testing budget is present.

assessments.o_overlap: O has protected regression checks and scoped candidate activation, but no standard per-skill deterministic+behavioral+semantic pre-commit gate followed by joint marginal-gain admission.
assessments.uncertainty_scope: Only five evolution rounds; the 14-task holdout is adaptively reused without sequential correction.

assessments.o_overlap: O has long-running candidate/learning lifecycle and rollback/checkpoint rules, but no matched 100-round bounded active-cap plus five-consecutive-regression rollback persistence controller.
assessments.uncertainty_scope: Ratchet reuses its held-out stream for lifecycle decisions/reporting and lacks a true lockbox.

assessments.o_overlap: O already performs strategy review when internal metrics stop yielding decision value, but it is not an autonomous post-training system that adapts a 30B model over weeks.
assessments.uncertainty_scope: Only four outer rounds and no missing statistical+semantic multi-gate composition.
